faqs.a: Asseto is a QR code-based fault management system. Every device or object gets a QR code sticker — just scan it with your phone to report a problem. No app installation, no registration required.
Anyone with access to the QR code — whether it's a public facility, gym, hotel, production plant, or anything else. The report form is accessible without logging in and works on any smartphone.

faqs.q: How do I generate a QR code for a device?
faqs.a: After adding a device in the panel, the QR code is generated automatically. You can choose the print size (S, M, L, XL), download a ready-to-print PDF, and stick it on the device. Each device has a unique code.

faqs.q: Do I need special hardware or an app?
faqs.a: No. You only need a web browser to manage your devices. To scan QR codes, a standard smartphone camera is enough — iOS and Android both support QR scanning natively without any additional apps.

faqs.q: How many devices can I add?
faqs.a: The free plan allows up to 10 devices. Paid plans support between 50 and 200 devices depending on the plan you choose.

faqs.q: Will I get notified about new reports?
faqs.a: Yes — after every new report, an email notification is sent to the address linked to your account, including a description of the problem, the device name, and a link to the panel.

Each issue has one of three statuses: Broken (new report requiring action), In service (issue being repaired), and Closed (repair complete). Changing the status automatically updates the device status as well.

faqs.q: Can I assign a service technician to a device?
faqs.a: Yes — each device can have a phone number and email address assigned to a service technician. From an issue, you can send them a ready-made email with the problem description in one click. Available on paid plans.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the free and paid plans?
faqs.a: The free plan lets you manage up to 10 devices and handle QR reports. Paid plans offer more devices, email notifications to technicians, a service portal, QR label editing, data export, and priority support.

faqs.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqs.a: You can cancel at any time from the panel under Settings → Subscription. Access to your paid plan remains active until the end of the current billing period.
Yes. Data is stored on Supabase servers with encryption. Payments are handled by Stripe — we never store card details. Each user only has access to their own devices and reports.

faqs.q: I have a question that's not listed here — what do I do?
faqs.a: Contact us via the Contact page or directly at marcin@asseto.pro. We respond within 24 hours.

helpIssues.title: Help — Issues
helpIssues.subtitle: Everything you need to know about reporting and managing issues.

sections.question: How does an employee report an issue?
sections.answer: Every machine has a QR code sticker. The employee scans it with their phone camera — no app installation, no login required. A form opens where they describe the problem and click "Submit". The report appears instantly in your panel.

sections.question: What do the issue statuses mean?

statuses.label: Broken
statuses.desc: New report — the machine needs repair.

statuses.label: In service
statuses.desc: The issue is currently being repaired.

sections.question: How do I change the issue status?
sections.answer: Go to the issue details — in the top right corner you'll find a dropdown menu with statuses. Changing the issue status automatically updates the machine status as well. When you close an issue, the machine returns to "Working" status.

sections.question: Will I get notified about a new issue?
sections.answer: Yes — after every new report you'll receive an email with the issue description, machine name and a link to the panel. Make sure you have the correct email address in your account settings.

sections.question: How do I notify the service technician about an issue?
sections.answer: In the issue details view you'll find a "Notify service" button. Clicking it will show a ready-made email with the machine details and issue description — you can edit it before sending. Available in the Pro plan.

sections.question: Where can I find the history of closed issues?
sections.answer: In the sidebar under "Issues" you have a "Closed" tab — there you'll find all completed reports. You can browse them and check when they were closed.

helpAssets.title: Help — Assets
helpAssets.subtitle: How to manage assets, QR codes and technical data.

sections.question: How do I add a new asset?
sections.answer: In the sidebar go to "Assets" and click "Add asset". Only the name is required — the serial number is optional. After adding you'll be redirected to the asset page where you can immediately generate a QR code.

sections.question: How does the QR code work?
sections.answer: Each asset has a unique QR code that leads to the report form. You can choose the print size (S, M, L, XL), download a PDF and stick it on the asset. The code can be regenerated at any time — the old one stops working.

sections.question: What are custom fields for?
sections.answer: Custom fields let you add any information to an asset — e.g. "Year of manufacture", "Engine model", "Last inspection". Each field has a name and a value. You can add and remove them at any time.

sections.question: What is the asset location?
sections.answer: Location is a text field describing where the asset is physically located — e.g. "Hall A, station 3" or "Floor 2, room 201". It appears in issue details, making it easier for the technician to find the asset.

sections.question: How do I set service technician details?
sections.answer: You can set a default phone number and email for the service technician in Settings — it will be automatically assigned to every new asset. You can also override it per asset in the "Technician" tab on the asset page.

sections.question: How do I add an asset photo?
sections.answer: On the asset page in the "Photo" section click "Add photo". Supported formats are JPG, PNG and WEBP. The photo appears in issue details making it easier to identify the asset. You can change or remove it at any time.

sections.question: Can I delete an asset?
sections.answer: Yes — on the asset page in the top right corner you'll find a delete button (trash icon). Deleting an asset is irreversible — all associated issues and data will be deleted along with it. Make sure you really want to do this.
